Title: What We Left Behind: Looking Back at Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
FullTitle: What We Left Behind: Looking Back at Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
SortTitle: What We Left Behind: Looking Back at Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
Plot: A documentary exploring the legacy of Star Trek: Deep Space Nine, the reasons it went from the black sheep of Star Trek to a beloved mainstay of the franchise, and a brainstorm with the original writers on what a theoretical eighth season of the show could look like.
